title: handle_move does not verify new actor's alsoKnownAs
description: inbox.rs:1489-1551. The handle_move function verifies that the OLD actor's alsoKnownAs includes the new target URI (line 1530-1537). However, per Mastodon's Move handling spec, both actors should have alsoKnownAs pointing to each other. The code only checks old -> new (line 1535), but does not verify that the NEW actor's alsoKnownAs includes the old actor URI. A malicious actor could set their alsoKnownAs to any URI and then send a Move activity claiming to migrate away, stealing follows if only one direction is checked.
